maya: Quick check-in on the routing editor UI. For workspaces with long rule lists the panel feels visually heavy and hard to scan — want to ideate a few lightweight fixes. jordan: Agreed. First pass: reduce row padding, pin the priority column, and make the drag handle more visible. sam: +1 on pinning priority. Also the validation copy is scary. Change 'Invalid rule' -> 'Conflicting rule' when it's a content conflict. taylor: Placement: simulation controls should live next to the preview header not the far-right toolbar. Users expect local controls. lee: Accessibility note: drag handle contrast is low (~2.2:1). Need >=4.5:1. Also keyboard reordering missing. maya: @lee can you paste a quick CSS and keyboard pattern? lee: CSS snippet: ```css .handle { color:#60666a; } .handle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset:2px; } ``` Keyboard pattern: Space to lift, arrow keys to move, Space to drop. Add `aria-describedby` when reorder is active. sam: Also the preview list updates aren't announced. Add `aria-live="polite"` to the preview container. jordan: Example: `
...
` taylor: For equal priorities show a tiny tie-breaker icon with tooltip showing created-at or rule-id so behaviour isn't mysterious. maya: I'll mock compact vs comfy rows + sticky priority col and keyboard demo. ETA: Thursday EOD. ana-bot: Linked PR #920 and will watch for the accessibility ticket. jordan: Action items: Maya - mocks; Lee - a11y ticket + tests; Sam - update copy & add 'View conflict' focus action; Taylor - move preview toggle; I'll schedule a 20-min review Friday. :calendar: maya: Thanks all — will drop mocks and a small HTML demo in thread when ready. Please flag anything that blocks signoff.
